title: Page 4
content_zh:
他眸光掠过一抹狐疑，今日所见的娄竹心，性子与他先前所听闻的似乎不太一样……

第2章(1)

两人出了林子停在岔路口，四下皆是荒芜的山丘，不见一人，无人可问询。

“走左边这条。”

在听见路挽风这么说时，寒招财眼珠子一转，指向右边，“我觉得走右边这条才对。”

“左边才对。”路挽风坚持。

寒招财也不与他相争，点头说道：“要不这样吧，你走左边那条，我走右边这条。”这样一来，她就可以趁机摆脱他。

“我们两人都是要回苏云城，为何要分开走，何况你一个姑娘……”

她抬手打断他的话，“既然我们挑选的路不同，何不分开走，不是有句话叫道不同不相为谋，虽然我是个姑娘，但我既有办法能从水里把你救起来，还能教你怎么分辨莲雾，自是有办法能自个儿回去，你就甭为我操心了。”

她打小在杏花村长大，又常在村子旁那座大山满山跑，要在荒郊野外求生，她比他还懂。反倒是他一个大少爷，要从这儿平安的走出去，怕是没那么容易，他该担心自己才是。

路挽风冷着脸纠正她，“那句话不是这么用。”

“什么？”

“道不同不相为谋，不是这么用。”

“是吗？”她摸摸鼻子，呵呵一笑。她从六岁到十岁，一直跟着大哥和二哥在族学里读书。本来娘不肯送她去上族学，后来她去求了身为村长的大伯和大伯娘，他们连生五个儿子，对她这唯一的侄女可疼得紧，她一撒娇就答应了她，还替她去劝了娘，她爹倒是不反对，于是她就在族学里跟着大哥和二哥学了五年，读书识字不成问题。

不过夫子教的那些四书五经，她同二哥一样，一读就头疼，但她算学倒是学得意外的好，就连夫子都夸她。

也不知是不是同她的名字有关，她打小就喜欢做一些能赚钱的事。

约莫八岁那年，因她爱吃桑椹，那年山上的野生桑椹被人摘光，她便央着爹在自个儿家的田里种几株桑树。

爹素来疼她，便在一亩旱田里，种下二十来株桑椹苗，而后桑椹结满果实，她和娘摘下那些桑椹，做成桑椹酱，趁着赶集时，拿去集市上卖。

后来有个妇人来偷摘她家桑叶，被她和爹抓到，那妇人说是因他们村子那儿的桑树得病全都死了，她家养的蚕没桑叶可吃，听说杏花村有种桑树，所以才会跑来偷摘，求他们放了他。

她当时提出交换条件，让妇人教她养蚕，以后便可以随时来摘桑叶，妇人答应了。

在她去妇人家学会以后，回来便教给娘和大伯娘，他们两家开始养蚕，两、三年后，她家和大伯家靠着养蚕，一年就能赚得一、两百两的银子，村子里其他的人见状，也开始跟着养蚕。

这期间她发现县城里的大户人家喜欢赏兰，便和二哥上山寻找一些罕见的兰花回来培养，等养好了，再送到城里去卖。

一株兰花的价格，好的话有时能值好几两银子，一年下来，往往能赚上几十两，村子里有人见了，也开始跟着上山找兰花来卖。

后来她见那些大户人家喜欢风雅，于是想出一个主意，将几种花草种在盆子里，再找来几块奇特的石头，或是做些小房子、小桥、小椅子摆在里头，做成一个小小的花园。

她和二哥先试做几个拿到城里去卖，当天就全被买走，赚了十五两银子，之后，村子又有人开始仿效他们做起那小花园来卖。

大伯和大伯娘常说她是村子里的福星，这些年来出了不少赚钱的主意，不仅让他们寒家，连带村子里的人也赚得不少银子，如今村民们顿顿都能吃到白米饭，孩子们也个个都长得很结实。

大伯娘还夸说娘给她取的名字没取错，果然很能招财。

也不知现下爹娘他们怎么样了？

她无论如何都得甩开路挽风，赶回家一趟，免得家人不知情，以为二哥真撞死她了。

想了想，寒招财提议道：“不如这样吧，眼前的路就只有两条，咱们两人总有一人能走对，你先走左边那条，我走右边这条，发现走错了，再回头就是了。”

见她似乎打定主意想自个儿走，路挽风略一思忖，退让一步，“你若非走右边这条，那咱们就先走这条试试吧。”

听他竟不再坚持，她有些错愕，“你不走左边那条了？”

“我不能丢下你自个儿走。”当初他溺水时，她既没弃他于不顾，他也不会弃她而去。

“我能照顾好自己，你用不着担心。”她巴不得赶紧同他分道扬镳，努力试着劝他去走左边那条。

见她一再想赶他走，路挽风若有所思的觑着她，“你在这种荒僻之地却毫无畏惧，看起来一点也不像养在深闺里的大家闺秀。”

“养在深闺里的大家闺秀看起来应当是什么样的？”寒招财反问他。

“当初我在问心观第一次见到你时，你温雅娴静，笑不露齿、行不露足。”说着，他瞥了眼她裙摆下光裸的一双莲足。

她垂眸看了眼自己那双白皙的双脚，笑了笑说：“鞋子先前落水时就丢失了，我不赤着脚还能怎么办，难不成要我爬着走不成？”说完，她意有所指的瞟了眼他脚上那双靴子，似笑非笑的劝了他一句，“你那靴子还没干透吧，这般穿在脚上恐会闷出脚气来。”

最后她再补上几句，“还有笑不露齿那是对陌生人才这般，咱们也算共患难过，没必要这般生疏。”从娄竹心残存的那些记忆里，她约莫知道原主生前是什么样的性情，那与她原本的性子不太一样，但现在又不在娄家，她没打算扮成像她那般温婉的淑女。

听见她这番话，路挽风轩眉微动，正要说什么，又听她启口再说：“哦，对了，你看起来也不像是会克妻的人。”

寒招财这般说，是有意想替原主出一口气。

她从原主的记忆里，得知路挽风曾先后定过两门亲事，第一次刚定完亲，那未婚妻就染了怪病暴毙；第二次订亲完不久，对方就在自个儿府里遭毒蛇咬死。后来路家又想为他再说一门亲，才刚请媒人去提，没想到那家的姑娘就被不知是谁乱扔的石子给砸得头破血流，吓得对方赶紧回了这桩婚事。

从此路挽风克妻之名传了开来，与路家门当户对的人家，一时之间没人再敢与他结亲。

后来娄竹心陪嫡母去问心观拜神，巧遇陪祖母去的路挽风，娄竹心对他一见钟情，被她嫡母看出来了。

她嫡母多半是觉得路挽风有克妻之名，怕是不好找到门当户对的姑娘，所以才怂恿她爹找人去向路家提出结亲之意，想趁此机会与路家攀上关系，没想到人家丝毫看不上娄家，更瞧不上她这区区庶女，毫不留情的回绝了。

闻言，路挽风脸色一沉，他哪会不知她是存心说这话来刺他，约莫是想报复当初他拒了与她的亲事。

他一个大男人，不想与她做这口舌之争，而且，不管怎么说，她终是有恩于他，因此纵使心中再不悦，他也没对她说出难听的话来，冷着脸提步走往右边那条路。

见他被她说得无话可回，寒招财翘起嘴角，慢吞吞的跟在他身后，一边寻思着要怎么样才能摆脱这人。

其实他若是翻脸骂她，她正好可以借机与他大吵一架，而后便可名正言顺的各走各的，哪里想到他竟能忍下这口气，一句话也不回。
content_en:
A flash of suspicion flashed across his eyes. The Lou Zhuxin he saw today seemed to have a different temperament than what he had heard before...

Chapter 2(1)

The two of them came out of the forest and stopped at a fork in the road. They were surrounded by deserted hills. There was no one in sight and no one to ask.

"Take the left path."

When he heard what Lu Wanfeng said, Han Zhaocai rolled his eyes and pointed to the right, "I think it's the right way to go."

"The left side is the right one." Lu Wanfeng insisted.

Han Zhaocai didn't fight with him, and nodded and said, "How about this, you take the left one, and I'll take the right one." In this way, she could take the opportunity to get rid of him.

"Both of us are going back to Suyuncheng, why should we leave separately, let alone a girl like you..."

She raised her hand to interrupt him, "Since we have chosen different paths, why don't we go separate ways? There is a saying that says different people don't work together. Although I am a girl, I have a way to rescue you from the water and teach you how to distinguish lotus mist. I have a way to go back on your own, so don't worry about me."

She grew up in Xinghua Village, and often ran all over the mountains next to the village. She knew better than him about surviving in the wilderness.On the contrary, as a young master, it might not be easy for him to get out of here safely. He should worry about himself.

Lu Wanfeng corrected her with a cold face, "That's not how that sentence is used."

"What?"

"Those who are different do not work together, that's not how it works."

"Really?" She touched her nose and smiled.From the age of six to ten, she studied with her eldest brother and second brother in the clan school.Originally, her mother refused to send her to go to clan school, but later she went to ask her eldest uncle and his mother-in-law, who were the village chiefs. They had five sons in a row, and they loved her only niece very much. She acted like a spoiled child and agreed to her, and even persuaded her mother on her behalf. Her father did not object, so she studied with her eldest brother and second brother in clan school for five years. Reading and literacy were no problem.

However, she, like her second brother, had a headache as soon as she read the Four Books and Five Classics taught by her master. However, she did surprisingly well in arithmetic, and even her master praised her.

I don’t know if it has something to do with her name. She has liked to do things that can make money since she was a child.

When she was about eight years old, because she loved eating mulberries, all the wild mulberries on the mountain were picked that year, so she asked her father to plant a few mulberry trees in her field.

Her father always loved her, so he planted about twenty mulberry seedlings in an acre of dry land, and then the mulberries became full of fruits. She and her mother picked the mulberries and made mulberry jam, which they sold at the market during the market.

Later, a woman came to pick mulberry leaves from her house and was caught by her and her father. The woman said that the mulberry trees in their village were sick and all died. Her silkworms had no mulberry leaves to eat. She heard that there were mulberry trees in Xinghua Village, so she came to pick them and begged them to let him go.

In exchange, she asked the woman to teach her how to raise silkworms so that she could pick mulberry leaves at any time. The woman agreed.

After she went to the woman's house to learn, she came back and taught her mother and her uncle's wife, and the two families started raising silkworms. Two or three years later, her family and her uncle's family were able to earn one or two hundred taels of silver a year from raising silkworms. Seeing this, other people in the village began to raise silkworms.

During this period, she discovered that wealthy families in the county liked to appreciate orchids, so she and her second brother went to the mountains to find some rare orchids and cultivate them. After they were cultivated, they were sent to the city for sale.

The price of an orchid can sometimes be worth several taels of silver if it is good. Over the course of a year, you can often earn dozens of taels. When people in the village saw it, they began to go up the mountain to look for orchids to sell.

Later, she saw that those wealthy families liked elegance, so she came up with an idea to plant several kinds of flowers and plants in pots, find a few strange stones, or make small houses, bridges, and chairs inside to create a small garden.

She and her second brother first tried making a few and sold them in the city. They were all bought on the same day, making fifteen taels of silver. After that, others in the village began to imitate them and start making small gardens to sell.

The eldest uncle and his mother-in-law often say that she is the lucky star of the village. Over the years, she has come up with many money-making ideas, which not only made their Han family, but also the people in the village a lot of money. Now the villagers can eat white rice every meal, and the children are all growing very strong.

The eldest uncle also boasted that the name her mother gave her was right and that it was indeed very good at attracting wealth.

I wonder how my parents are doing now?

No matter what, she had to get off the road and rush home to prevent her family from knowing and thinking that her second brother had really killed her.

After thinking about it, Han Zhaocai suggested: "How about this. There are only two roads in front of you. One of us can always take the right path. You take the left one first, and I take the right one. If you find that you are going wrong, just turn back."

Seeing that she seemed to have made up her mind to go alone, Lu Wanfeng thought for a moment and gave in. "If you don't want to take the right way, then let's try this way first."

She was a little surprised to hear that he didn't insist anymore, "You don't want to take the left one?"

"I can't leave you alone." When he drowned, she didn't abandon him, and he wouldn't abandon her.

"I can take care of myself, you don't have to worry." She wanted to part ways with him quickly and tried hard to persuade him to take the left one.

Seeing her repeatedly trying to drive him away, Lu Wanfeng looked at her thoughtfully, "You are fearless in such a remote place. You don't look like a lady raised in a boudoir at all."

"What should a lady raised in a boudoir look like?" Han Zhaocai asked him.

"When I first met you in the Guan Xin Guan, you were gentle and quiet, smiling without showing your teeth and walking without showing your feet." As he said this, he glanced at her bare lotus feet under her skirt.

She lowered her eyes and glanced at her white feet, smiled and said, "The shoes were lost when they fell into the water. What can I do if I don't have bare feet? Is it possible that I can't crawl on it?" After saying that, she glanced at the boots on his feet pointedly, and persuaded him with a half-smile, "Your boots haven't dried out yet. Wearing them like this on your feet will probably suffocate athlete's foot."

Finally, she added a few words, "Smiling but not showing teeth is the way to treat strangers. We all share the same sorrow, there is no need to be so unfamiliar." From the remaining memories of Lou Zhuxin, she roughly knew what the original owner's temperament was like during his lifetime. It was different from her original temperament, but now that he was not in the Lou family, she had no intention of pretending to be a gentle lady like her.

Hearing her words, Lu Wanfeng's eyebrows moved slightly. He was about to say something when he heard her speak again: "Oh, by the way, you don't look like someone who knows how to restrain his wife."

Han Zhaocai said this because he wanted to help the original owner.

From the memory of the original owner, she learned that Lu Wanfeng had engaged in two marriages. Just after the first engagement, his fiancée contracted a strange disease and died suddenly; not long after the second engagement, the fiancée was bitten to death by a poisonous snake in his house.Later, the Lu family wanted to arrange another marriage for him, and they just asked a matchmaker to propose it. Unexpectedly, the girl from that family was hit with a bloody head by stones thrown by an unknown person, which frightened the other party and hurriedly refused to propose the marriage.

From then on, Lu Wanfeng's reputation as a wife-killer spread, and no one from the same family as the Lu family dared to marry him anymore.

Later, Lou Zhuxin accompanied her aunt to go to Wenxin Temple to worship God. By chance, she met Lu Wanfeng who was accompanying her grandmother. Lou Zhuxin fell in love with him at first sight, and her aunt noticed it.

Her aunt probably felt that Lu Wanfeng had a reputation of being a wife-suppressant, and was afraid that it would be difficult to find a girl of the right family, so she encouraged her father to find someone to propose marriage to the Lu family, hoping to take this opportunity to establish a relationship with the Lu family. Unexpectedly, they looked down upon the Lou family at all, let alone her, a mere concubine, and refused mercilessly.

Hearing this, Lu Wanfeng's face darkened. How could he not know that she said this deliberately to stab him, probably because she wanted to take revenge on him for rejecting her marriage.

He was a grown man and didn't want to get into this verbal quarrel with her, and no matter what, she was still kind to him, so even though he was unhappy in his heart, he didn't say anything unpleasant to her, and walked to the right with a cold face.

Seeing that he had nothing to say in response to what she said, Han Zhaocai raised the corners of his lips and followed him slowly, thinking about how to get rid of this person.

In fact, if he turns against her and scolds her, she can take the opportunity to have a big quarrel with him, and then they can go their separate ways. Who would have thought that he could endure this tone without replying a word.
